title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might cascade RL and multi-domain distillation mean for the next generation of autonomous systems?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 enables more nuanced reasoning and agentic behavior through its 30B MoE and on-policy distillation.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if these models become too autonomous, who ensures they align with human values and don’t reinforce existing biases?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating value-aligned reward models and using human feedback loops during training to mitigate risks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents collaborate with humans in complex domains like healthcare and climate science.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with ethical guardrails — and Nemotron-Cascade 2 may be our bridge.
